title: tephroseris elodes subsp. coincyi
intro: Tephroseris elodes subsp. coincyi, commonly known as Alpine Hawk's Beak, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, such as diarrhea and indigestion, and offering anti-inflammatory and antibacterial effects. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Hawk's Beak include its ability to soothe the digestive tract, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant are rich in flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
